method: Whole-file manual reading of Finnish catalog; source bytes reverified against pinned Git blob; v91 structural evidence retained.
findings: Todennäköiset kaksoiskappaleet, Hashin etuliite and Otantatiiviste preserve probability/prefix/sampling distinctions. Advanced option explicitly says sample digests above64MiB.

Recovery completion requests checking file data, separates recoverable from recovery-may-succeed and warns that same-source-volume restoration can replace deleted data. Metadata changes request rescan. No recovery runtime qualified.

Collapse rendered Palauta can suggest restore rather than collapse; component store rendered Komponenttikauppa can suggest a shop; hardlinks vary between Kovakytkökset, kovat linkit and kovalinkit. These are terminology concerns, not reproduced library defects.

General size-format caption uses Gt/Mt/kt while unit keys use GiB/MiB/KiB; actual size formatting needs runtime verification. Sparse action remains distinct from compression and logical/physical labels are explicit.
Cloud warning explains potential download and adjustable settings; delete tooltip says cannot recover, which is not evidence of secure erasure.
Regex versus glob, cleanup %p/%n/%sp/%sn and ordered permission lists are retained. MSI fi-FI/1035/1252 declarations alone do not prove installer encoding.
limits: No native-speaker certification, rendered UI, mnemonic conflict, installer or Windows runtime verification. No foreign production code adopted.
Native pHash investigation deferred; completed repository count remains147/500.
